content:
# Disagreement Log — 1QM Column 1

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 1:1 | "the putting-forth-of-the-hand" | "the first engagement" | "the first attack" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "the first attack" — clearer than EMET's compound; more precise than LOGOS |
| 2 | 1:1 | "the In[structor]" | "the Instructor" | "the Teacher" | Sectarian term | SOPHIA: "the Instructor" — maskil is a Qumran technical title best rendered formally |
| 3 | 1:2 | "the dwellers-of Philistia" | "the inhabitants of Philistia" | "the Philistine territories" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "the inhabitants of Philistia" — formal yet clear |
| 4 | 1:2 | "helpers of wickedness" | "allies in wickedness" | "partners in evil" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "allies in wickedness" — preserves Hebrew sense without archaic tone |
| 5 | 1:5 | "to-cut-off the horn-of" | "to cut off the horn of" | "shatter their power" | Interpretive | SOPHIA: "to shatter the power of" — renders horn metaphor for clarity |
| 6 | 1:6 | "eternal destruction" | "everlasting destruction" | "total, permanent ruin" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "everlasting destruction" — formal biblical register preferred |
| 7 | 1:7 | "great panic" | "great panic" | "Terror will seize" | Structural | SOPHIA: "great terror" — compromise between EMET/LOGOS and PNEUMA |
| 8 | 1:7 | "wickedness shall-be brought-low" | "wickedness shall be subdued" | "Evil will be crushed" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "wickedness shall be brought low" — closest to Hebrew hukna' |
| 9 | 1:9 | "going-on shining" | "continuing to shine" | "blazing brighter and brighter" | Interpretive | SOPHIA: "continuing to shine" — PNEUMA adds intensification absent from Hebrew |
| 10 | 1:10 | "fierce-destruction" | "terrible destruction" | "fierce and devastating battle" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "fierce destruction" — closest to Hebrew without expansion |
| 11 | 1:11 | "the war-of extermination" | "the war of annihilation" | "the final war to annihilate" | Structural | SOPHIA: "the war of annihilation" — preserves construct without restructuring |
| 12 | 1:11 | "congregation-of the divine-ones" | "congregation of the divine beings" | "the heavenly assembly" | Sectarian term | SOPHIA: "congregation of the divine beings" — 'adat 'elim rendered formally |
| 13 | 1:13 | "battle-cry of divine-ones and of-men" | "war cry of divine beings and of men" | "battle cries of angels and warriors" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "war cry of divine beings and men" — avoids PNEUMA's interpretive "angels" |
| 14 | 1:13 | "a time-of tribulation" | "a time of distress" | "the worst crisis" | Register | SOPHIA: "a time of distress" — PNEUMA too colloquial for sectarian text |
| 15 | 1:14 | "from its hastening" | "from its onset" | "from the first clash" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "from its beginning" — neutral rendering of mehishtah |
| 16 | 1:15 | "shall strengthen-themselves to-turn-back" | "shall brace themselves to force back" | "will rally to push back" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "shall brace themselves to drive back" — combines LOGOS form with clarity |
| 17 | 1:16 | "shall-melt the-heart" | "shall cause hearts to melt" | "will spread terror" | Interpretive | SOPHIA: "shall cause hearts to melt" — preserves Hebrew idiom; PNEUMA too free |

**Total disagreements: 17**
